turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of what he already wrote? On what evidence, Hale?
You haven't told me who decided, whether Owen was heard, or what evidence you have. I'm still sitting here.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I'll want it in writing. It still doesn't tell me what you have against him.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale (cc: Principal),

Today you said a supervised rewrite would replace Owen's zero and that nothing would go on his record. I still require that commitment in writing, along with who decided on the zero, whether Owen was heard before it was entered, and whatever evidence you have. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, where she took your promise that nothing would go on his record and still wants it in writing, along with who decided, whether Owen was heard, and your evidence; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you didn't get there because you never showed any evidence.
What moved her: you said the rewrite would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, which met the one thing she will never trade.
What cost ground: you offered the rewrite before showing anything, so it looked like a fix for a case you hadn't made.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence, so nothing you said came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she opened by asking who decided and whether Owen was heard, answer that directly, own entering the zero before calling home, and show one dated document before you bring up the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
